lines: Make haste. We have received orders from her to withdraw.
At the far end of the cave, two high-ranking demons were examining the cave walls.
The Gate to the Devildom that was here must have been closed for hundreds of years. It is no longer usable.
Were it still in working order, this would have been a valuable base... but there is nothing to be done. Leave it alone.
But even if it's a closed gate, we can still gather valuable data if we study it.
We've been conducting an extensive investigation, even enlisting the help of someone like her...
Lingering attachment will lead ye to ruination, sorcerer. It would appear that the Succubi who neglected their watch were defeated by someone.
No way, somewhere this deep in the mountains!?
We may be deep in the mountains, but do not forget that there is a den of Taimanin nearby.
Taimanin...? Don't tell me the illusion of her Phantom Circle was broken by the Taimanin!
Those detestable Taimanin. It is not surprising that someone with the power to break her illusion exists among them.
But after all the trouble we've gone through to find this place, handing it over to the Taimanin is...
O~hoho, I have no intention of handing it over to anyone.
Look, the Taimanin are here. Stall for time. I will take care of the rest.
